header.title: How to Repair a Crystal Chandelier
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to repair a broken arm on a crystal chandelier using foam, wire, and glue.

steps.description: Carve a foam block to match the shape of a chandelier arm, ensuring a stable work environment.
actions: Ensure the chandelier is on a flat and stable work surface.
Ensure the work area is free from traffic and undisturbed for 24 to 36 hours.
Use a utility knife to carve out the foam block.
Carve the foam block so that it perfectly conforms to the shape of an undamaged chandelier arm.

steps.description: Check the fit of the broken crystal chandelier arm piece by aligning it with the chandelier base using a craft foam block.
actions: Lay the broken crystal chandelier arm piece into the craft foam block
Gently push the broken edge of the crystal arm up against the chandelier base
Check if the broken edges fit together perfectly
Adjust the foam block so that the two broken pieces of the crystal arm match

steps.description: Ensure the craft foam provides adequate support for the broken crystal arm before gluing it to the chandelier base, and use metal hanging wire for additional support if needed.
actions: Check if the craft foam piece will adequately support the arm
Use metal hanging wire to help hold the broken crystal arm securely in place while it dries (if needed)

steps.description: Secure the broken crystal arm using metal wire, twisting it around the arm and chandelier top for support.
actions: Use metal hanging wire
Twist the wire around the loose part of the broken crystal arm
Twist the wire around the chandelier top
Use as many pieces of wire as needed to securely stabilize the broken piece

steps.description: Prepare the arm for gluing by freeing any restricted wires and repositioning the craft foam.
actions: Untwist the wires
Push the craft foam piece back from the base

steps.description: Glue the broken crystal arm back onto the base, ensuring proper alignment and securing it with wires and foam.
actions: Apply instant glass glue to the broken edges of the crystal arm according to the manufacturer's directions.
Fit the broken arm piece to the broken edge on the base carefully.
Make sure the arm and base line up evenly.
Re-twist the metal wires that were holding the arm in place.
Make sure that the craft foam is securely seated underneath the arm.

steps.description: Allow the glued glass to dry completely, then remove support materials and hang the chandelier.
actions: Allow the instant glass glued to dry for at least 24 hours
Allow the glue to dry for 36 hours before moving the chandelier
Remove the metal wires
Remove the foam blocks
Hang the crystal chandelier back on its mounting brace
